item: Priors are scoped to the dataset where several are properties of a column, which mis-fires on exactly the mixed tables the product targets
detail: missingness_direction is not a fact about a table - it is a fact about each column. NHANES-shaped data holds dietary columns, lab columns and questionnaire columns side by side, and a dataset-level 'below detection limit' prior is wrong for most of them. The scoping information already exists: _left_censored returns the columns it identified. It simply is not used to scope the prior it justifies.
ev: turbotab/packs.py:196 _left_censored returns columns; priors() at :889 takes only a question name
act: Scope column-level priors to the columns their detector named. Dataset-level priors (model_ranking) stay as they are.
note: Fixed at L20 and AUDITED AT L21. Prior carries scope (dataset or columns) and a column-scoped prior must name the DETECTOR whose columns it applies to - __post_init__ refuses one that does not, because a column-scoped prior with no detector applies to everything, which is this finding restated. The scoping information already existed and simply was not used: _left_censored now exposes params['columns'] with the FULL censored list rather than the eight the card shows, since a prior scoped to a display truncation would be wrong about 296 of them. prior_columns() returns None rather than [] when a detector did not fire, and the difference is the whole finding - an empty list says 'this prior applies to no columns' and None says 'the evidence for this prior is absent', which is why the prior is WITHHELD rather than rendered over nothing. Measured: the metabolomics missingness prior scopes to 307 columns on its own fixture and is withheld entirely on dietary_recalls. The clinical prior scopes through the engine's own exact-match reference matcher, so on an NHANES-shaped table it lands on the labs and not the questionnaire items beside them. TWO PRIORS ARE DELIBERATELY DATASET-SCOPED with the reason on the declaration: model_ranking, because p >> n is a property of the shape; and qc_rows_excluded, because it is about ROWS and forcing it into a column list it does not have would be this finding's error committed in the act of repairing it. THE L21 AUDIT ASKED WHETHER THE WHOLE FINDING WAS CLOSED OR ONLY THE SKIP PATH, and the answer is the whole scope property, carried by three assertions: no ACTING consumer resolves a column-scoped prior without a frame, checked across every call site in api.py and repeats.py rather than the one path the finding named; a column-scoped prior resolved without a frame carries no columns key at all, so the catalogue reading is legal and cannot be acted on by accident; and every column-scoped prior names a detector some fixture actually produces, because a detector name resolving to nothing would withhold the prior forever, which is a silence rather than a scope. WHAT IS NOT CLOSED IS A DIFFERENT FINDING: four priors have no consumer at all, filed as GUIDED-030. That is GUIDED-024's defect surviving for a subset rather than a scope problem, and conflating the two would have closed a row against work nobody did. Probed at L20: removing the withholding branch makes the prior apply to a table its detector never fired on.
verified_against: TurboTab @ HEAD - adjudicator review of the routing matrix, 2026-07-29

item: The lens contradiction detector fires in one direction only: assay-shaped data described as something else, never the reverse
detail: contradiction() detects a wide numeric table stated as non-assay. A user who answers 'metabolomics' over a 40-column clinical table gets nothing, and that is the direction where a wrong lens silently applies log-transform and Pareto scaling to data that wants neither. suggest() is likewise asymmetric - it hints genomics, metabolomics, survey and dietary, and never clinical.
ev: turbotab/packs.py:954 contradiction(); :923 suggest()
act: Detect the reverse: a stated assay lens over a table with too few numeric columns to be a panel. Same escalation rule - evidence the reading is wrong, not the size of the consequence.
note: CLOSED at L21. Three directions now, not one, and they are separate because they are wrong about different things. (1) The original: a wide numeric table stated as non-assay. (2) THE ONE THAT COSTS: a stated assay lens over a table with too few numeric columns to be a panel. Before the priors layer was wired a wrong lens was cosmetic; it now settles every blank column as below-the-detection-limit at derived confidence, withholds the mechanism question for all of them, and schedules half-minimum imputation on data that wants a different reading - so the message says what the wrong lens would DO rather than only that it looks wrong. (3) A stated genomics lens over values that are not counts, kept separate from (2) because a wide table of concentrations IS a panel, so (2) stays quiet, and the p >> n prior it sets is right while the count reading underneath it is not. IT FIRES BEFORE ANY PRIOR IS GRANTED, AND THAT IS ENFORCED RATHER THAN SEQUENCED. set_lens raises LensContradiction unless acknowledged, so there is no state in which the lens is recorded, three hundred questions are withheld, and the disagreement is raised afterwards - a user watching the questions vanish and then being told the lens looks wrong has already lost the thread. Both exits travel on the refusal, as they do for grain, so an interface cannot render the interruption without rendering its way out; attesting records the disagreement into the methods section rather than losing it. suggest() FIXED RATHER THAN EXPLAINED: it now hints clinical, through the engine's own exact reference matcher rather than a sixth name list. The bar is two recognized measurements, deliberately low, because a hint is a suggestion that costs nothing to ignore and is not allowed to change a default - it belongs where a reader would start guessing, not where a detector would be confident. Every lens is asserted NOT contradicted on the fixture it fits, because a detector that fires on correct answers gets switched off. Probed, three reverts, each red for its stated reason.
verified_against: TurboTab @ HEAD - adjudicator review of the routing matrix, 2026-07-29

item: detect_cohort_structure matched column names by SUBSTRING against three local pattern lists, so a wellbeing score was a patient identifier and an income column was a time column
detail: entity_id_patterns, clinical_measurement_patterns and time_patterns were local lists inside detect_cohort_structure, matched with any(pattern in col_lower for pattern in ...). Measured false positives: subject_matter_code, subjects_enrolled_total, membership_fee, encounter_cost and recordkeeping_score all read as entity IDs; yearly_income and timepoint_label read as time columns. Both feed whether the data is read as longitudinal, which pages/01_Upload_and_Audit.py consumes and which decides how held-out rows are chosen. THE FIFTH INSTANCE of the substring-registry class after clinical_units, physiology_reference, theory_anchors and IMPORT-267's _KNOWN_UNITS, and the first invisible to an audit of module-level constants, because all three lists are LOCAL VARIABLES.

The cost is stated rather than hidden: SEQN, USUBJID and study_id are real identifiers this will not recognize until somebody declares them, and that is correct, because a gap is visible to the user and costs a question while a wrong claim is invisible and licenses a split. It used subjective_wellbeing as a float and the probe came back GREEN - the entity-ID branch has a downstream cardinality-and-dtype gate that drops float columns with decimals, so the substring match fired and was then discarded for an unrelated reason. item: Per-column questions scale linearly with column count, so a wide table without a matching pack gets hundreds of questions - the lens masks this rather than solving it
detail: The L20 discrimination matrix records metabolomics_untargeted at a BASE of 313 questions - 308 columns with blanks producing 308 mechanism questions, roughly ten times Classic's ~32. The metabolomics pack rescues it to 6. A user with the same table who answers 'something else, or not sure' still gets 313, and so does any wide table in a field no pack covers. This is a class, not one question: missingness, encoding, power transform and outlier handling are all asked per column, and each is unbounded in p. The remedy is already specified and was built for transforms but not for these - operations apply to sets defined by a RULE and the user edits the rule, not the members ('308 columns have blanks. Answer once for all of them, or review them individually'), which scales identically at 12 columns and 12,000.
ev: L20 discrimination matrix, metabolomics_untargeted base=313; DOMAIN_PACKS.md 02; the p>>n scoping rule
act: Give every per-column question a bulk affordance with an editable rule. The lens then accelerates a scalable interview instead of rescuing an unscalable one.
note: FIXED at L21 in turbotab/bulk.py plus project.route_missingness_bulk and a rewritten missingness branch in ml/router.py. MEASURED: metabolomics_untargeted's base falls from 312 questions to 7, and the interview count is now O(1) in the column count rather than O(p) - 12 columns, 1200 and 12000 all produce the same number of pushed questions, asserted at both ends because a bulk affordance tested only on the wide case can hide a threshold that makes the narrow case worse. FOUR PROPERTIES, each of which the design would be wrong without. Grouped by DTYPE, because clause 07 routes by dtype and one blanket answer across both branches would have to be wrong for one of them. The group is what REMAINS after pack priors settle their columns, and a group below MIN_GROUP is asked individually - a rule over one column is a column with extra words in front of it. ONE decision covering N columns, with one cascade entry rather than N, and a methods sentence that reads 'missing values in 306 numeric columns will be filled using the median within each training fold' - the sentence a reader wants. And BULK PLUS EVIDENCE-DRIVEN EXCEPTIONS: where the user answers not-informative and the outcome behaves differently wherever a column is blank, those columns are surfaced - as ONE question naming them, because 500 exceptions asked one at a time is the unbounded interview arriving through the back door. The reverse direction is deliberately not reported: 'you said informative and we see no association' is an absence of evidence, and escalating on one would be the app arguing with a claim it cannot check. THE USER EDITS THE RULE, NOT THE MEMBERS - except_from_bulk narrows the set and the rule's own sentence says '1 you pulled out'. A SECOND SCALING PROBLEM WAS FOUND AND FIXED IN THE SAME LOOP: wiring the priors layer at L20 turned 306 questions into 306 SKIPS, which is a real improvement in what is asked and none at all in what is drawn. Skips are now grouped the same way, one stated fact per pack per branch, because DESIGN_LANGUAGE 09 wants skips to group so their density reads as machine work at a glance and 306 of them is not a glance. THE MATRIX SHRANK AND THAT IS NOT A REGRESSION: the metabolomics delta falls from -307 to -1 because the baseline got honest, not because the pack got worse. Both bases are recorded in VALUE_CHECK_ADJUDICATION.md so a later loop can tell a real regression from this correction. Probed, five reverts; one came back RED FOR THE WRONG REASON because MIN_GROUP=1 fires the first assertion rather than the second, and was re-declared against the assertion the probe actually reads.

item: Four pack priors still have no consumer - GUIDED-024's defect surviving for a subset, now declared and counted rather than noticed
detail: energy_adjustment, ordinal_encoding, reverse_coding and qc_rows_excluded are reasoned, shape-tested and read by nothing. Each has a different reason and only one is a gap in wiring: energy_adjustment needs an energy-adjustment step that is not built; ordinal_encoding carries the ROW-LOCAL claim, and the recipe table holds scope per operation rather than per column so its variant migrated and its scope claim could not; reverse_coding is deliberately not wired, because gating the question on the prior would let a pack turn the question off and guard 1 forbids that, so the prior is the RECORD of a considered refusal. QC_ROWS_EXCLUDED IS THE SHARPEST AND THE ONLY ONE THAT IS A REAL DEFECT: the metabolomics pack states at derived confidence that pooled QC injections are not participants and that modeling them is an error with no legitimate reading, the finding is surfaced, and nothing acts on it - so the app still models them.
ev: turbotab/packs.py PACKS priors; test_every_prior_has_a_consumer_or_is_declared_unconsumed lists the four with their reasons
act: Wire qc_rows_excluded first: it needs a row-exclusion step, which is also what the eligibility question already does for a different reason. energy_adjustment waits on the step. ordinal_encoding waits on per-column scope in the recipe table. reverse_coding stays declared-and-unwired on purpose and its entry should say so permanently rather than being closed.
note: Found at L21 while auditing GUIDED-027 rather than by a detector, and filed rather than fixed because three of the four wait on steps that do not exist. The residue is now COUNTABLE: test_every_prior_has_a_consumer_or_is_declared_unconsumed asserts the inert set equals the declared set in both directions, so a fifth cannot join quietly and a declaration cannot outlive its reason. Same shape as the substring-registry guard - the failure mode is silence, so silence is a test failure.

item: explainOnly renders suggested_actions as prose bullets and terminates - the one moment the user needs to act is the one place the card offers nothing to act on
detail: Two preview branches exist. previewFor renders a real before/after with an Apply button when the engine proposes a repair. explainOnly fires when it does not, prints f.suggested_actions as em-dash paragraphs, and closes with 'the engine reports this without proposing a repair'. That is honest about the engine and a dead end for the user, who is standing at the exact moment a decision is due. And suggested_actions is already a list of options in prose costume - 'consider winsorizing', 'tree models are robust', 'investigate if outliers are errors' are three different decisions rendered as bullets. This is the same failure as the original Train-page critique that started the project (DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md 01.4, 'three attributes wearing a sentence costume'), surviving the rewrite by moving branch.
ev: turbotab/web/index.html:1279 explainOnly; contrast :1317 previewFor
act: explainOnly stops being terminal. Split suggested_actions into app-operations, which become options each carrying a preview, and human tasks, which become earmarks with a target step. Every option is applicable now or earmarked; clause 06 decides which executes when and the decision sentence states the timing. A deferred option previews as a read-only simulation labeled 'preview, not applied'.
note: Filed by the adjudicator from the product owner's drive. Their framing: this is the exact moment the dynamic mechanic belongs - choose or earmark, and show what the choice does to the data.

item: The reverse lens contradiction asserts 'too few to be a panel' at 10 numeric columns, which is false for targeted metabolomics and over-fires on weak evidence
detail: Targeted metabolomics and proteomics panels routinely measure 10 to 50 analytes, so a 10-column assay table is ordinary rather than contradictory. The detector keys on column count alone, which does not discriminate targeted assay from clinical chemistry, and the message states a falsehood inside the mechanism built to catch false readings. The cost it guards against also scales with width: on 10 columns a wrong assay lens grants 10 skips, not 300, so the escalation is disproportionate to the evidence - the rule is escalate on evidence a reading is wrong, never on the size of the consequence.
ev: turbotab/packs.py contradiction(); L21 report, the ! cells
act: Key on something that discriminates - feature-name shape, or the absence of any left-censored missingness pattern - rather than column count. If evidence stays weak, demote from a 409 to an advisory beside the answer.
note: Filed by the adjudicator reviewing the L21 matrix.
